summary: Regression verification after the PlanDiscountBadges stable-key change (src/pages/FeesStructure.jsx). Backend pytest: 11/11 passed (previously-skipped parent-portal test now passes because parent.gn20250001 has linked_student_ids in seed). Frontend UI: admin login OK, /fees renders with 'Plan Discounts' column and 'Class I 2026-27 (Discount Demo)' plan visible with badges (Plan 10% / Yearly ₹1000 / 1 month), no console errors. Add Plan dialog: created a plan with 10% + ₹1000 yearly + April ₹200; live preview showed gross ₹12,000, net ₹9,600, You save 20%, Apr ₹616.67 vs May ₹816.67 (per-month math correct). Save persisted; Edit reopens with plan_discount_value=10, yearly_discount_value=1000, april chip present. Parent portal /parent/pay shows banner 'You saved ₹2,400.00 this session with plan discounts.'; Pay Full (Annual) tab shows 'Plan discount -₹2,400.00' and 'Net annual ₹9,600.00'. No regressions detected from the React-key change.
critical_code_review_comments: PlanDiscountBadges now uses a stable string key derived from badge text – safe, no visible re-render regression.
Backward-compat still holds: pre-existing plans without discount fields render '—' in the Plan Discounts column.
seed_data_creation: Created (and cleaned up) 'TEST_UI_Regr_*' plan via UI and pytest-created TEST_Discount_Plan_* / TEST_Sched_Plan_* plans; all deleted (including breaking the pytest assignment then deleting) so DB has no TEST_ plans remaining.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All plan-baked discount flows (CRUD, validation, math, fee-schedule, parent portal banner + full-year tab) verified end-to-end. Cleanup note: the DELETE /api/fees/plans/{id} endpoint returns 400 while the plan still has assignments — pytest's session teardown does NOT currently unassign first, so plans created in TestStudentFeeSchedule may linger in DB across runs; this is a test-suite cleanup gap, not a product bug. Recommend the next testing agent enhance the cleanup fixture to also DELETE /api/fees/assignments/{aid} for plans it created before attempting plan delete.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. The React-key refactor in PlanDiscountBadges is functionally inert.
